verdict.rationale: Sentry is an SDK-based application monitoring platform and explicitly markets 'No agents to install'. The pack shows no vendor-maintained agents or integrations for host, container, Kubernetes, or cloud-infrastructure telemetry. OTLP ingestion depends on third-party OpenTelemetry SDKs or Collectors, and the Cloudflare Workers integration is application error capture, so neither counts as infrastructure instrumentation.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services through vendor-maintained agents and integrations
